description: When did OPM last close federal offices or allow early departure? Lists the US Office of Personnel Management's past operating status postings for the Washington, DC area, newest first: closures, delayed arrivals, early departures, unscheduled leave or telework days and lapses in appropriations, each with the date it applied to and when it was posted and replaced. Useful for HR, payroll and contractor questions. Ordinary open days are mostly not listed, and the online history covers recent years only. (cost: 1 credit)

count.description: integer, optional, number of postings to return, 1-100, default 20

startrow.description: integer, optional, how many of the newest postings to skip (for paging), default 0

name: opm_status_history
